actions.name: magic resistance
actions.desc: The [[lookup @name lowercase]]{monster} has Advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

actions.name: demonic restoration
actions.desc: If the [[lookup @name lowercase]]{monster} dies outside the Abyss, its body dissolves into ichor, and it gains a new body instantly, reviving with all its Hit Points somewhere in the Abyss.

actions.name: reactive
actions.desc: The [[lookup @name lowercase]]{monster} can take one &Reference[Reaction] on every turn of combat.

actions.name: multiattack
actions.desc: The [[lookup @name lowercase]]{monster} makes six [[/item .mmPactBlade00000]] attacks and uses [[/item .mmConstrict00000]].

actions.name: constrict
actions.desc: Strength Saving Throw: DC [[lookup @save.dc.value activity=IgOMjRxAt7UISkJq]], one [[lookup @target.affects.special activity=IgOMjRxAt7UISkJq]] creature the [[lookup @name lowercase]]{monster} can see within [[lookup @range.value activity=IgOMjRxAt7UISkJq]] feet. Failure: [[/damage average]] damage. The target has the &Reference[Grappled apply=false] condition (escape DC [[lookup @skills.ath.passive]]), and it has the &Reference[Restrained apply=false] condition until the grapple ends.

actions.name: teleport
actions.desc: The [[lookup @name lowercase]]{monster} teleports up to [[lookup @range.value activity=dnoRMdFzhUUku26D]] feet to an unoccupied space it can see.

actions.name: parry
actions.desc: Trigger: The [[lookup @name lowercase]]{monster} is [[lookup @activation.condition activity=aLG3BRZL7P6OEjwd]]. Response: The [[lookup @name lowercase]]{monster} adds [[lookup @roll.formula activity=aLG3BRZL7P6OEjwd]] to its AC against that attack, possibly causing it to miss.
